newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Credit shares keep rising on tie-up.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Credit shares keep rising on tie-up.

text.p: Shares in Nippon Credit Bank Ltd rose on Monday morning, drawing continued strength from news last week that the bank plans to tie up with Bankers Trust New York Corp.
Some brokers said a fair amount of shares were being bought for margin trading, which was also helping the share price to climb.

As of 0136 GMT, the shares were 23 yen or 9.58 percent higher at 263, with trade totalling 15.98 million shares. The issue was the second largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse as well as the most actively traded share.
